translation.name: Chile
translation.summary: Chile brings together the Atacama Desert, southern Patagonia, the Lake District, Santiago, Valparaíso and Easter Island. Ada Tours can design a nature-focused or active itinerary with wine regions, food experiences and motorcycle journeys, or combine Chile with Argentina and other South American countries.

translation.bestTime: Seasons are the reverse of the Northern Hemisphere: summer falls in December–February and winter in June–August.

featureBands.title: San Pedro de Atacama
featureBands.text: The Atacama Desert offers a remarkable contrast of high-altitude landscapes, lagoons, salt flats, geysers and the Valley of the Moon. Explore the region as a dedicated nature-focused part of your journey.

featureBands.title: Punta Arenas and Torres del Paine
featureBands.text: Travel south through Punta Arenas and Puerto Natales to Torres del Paine, combining glaciers, cruises, trekking and the scenic roads of Patagonia.

featureBands.title: Easter Island
featureBands.text: Rapa Nui is distinct from mainland Chile. Travellers come for the moai, volcanic landscapes and island culture, making it worth planning as a dedicated part of a longer journey through Chile.

translation.body:
Chile offers strikingly different natural landscapes within one country. In the north, your route may begin in San Pedro de Atacama, then continue south into the Lake District and Patagonia, with its glaciers, forests and national parks.

For the urban part of the journey, explore Santiago, Valparaíso and Viña del Mar. Add wine valleys and local food experiences, then continue towards the coast or the Andes.

Southern Patagonia lends itself to trekking, cruises, glacier excursions and active journeys. Highlights include Punta Arenas, Puerto Natales, Torres del Paine, the Serrano and Balmaceda glaciers and the Lake District.

Easter Island adds an entirely different cultural and natural experience. Ada Tours can organise an individual journey through Chile or combine it with Argentina and other South American destinations.
